name: strata-v100-resident-2x
description: Q2_0 fully resident on two V100-32G cards (volta05), 1k-128k at C1/2/4.

estimate.basis: 2026-10-26 phase A budget (one server, Q2_0 on 2x V100)

caveats: This is phase A of the one-allocation wrapper llm/strata/experiments/2026-10-26-v100-run.sh; that wrapper stages the 28.8 GB PLE shard once for A/B/E. Running this recipe alone pays the Lustre staging read again.
Full residency must be proven from the engine log ('100% of the experts resident'), not assumed.
The Q2_0 shard1 is 37.6 GB; delete it from /tmp after the phase if the next pack needs the space.
Only 131072:1 is attempted at the top; 131072 C>1 was not in the historical plan.
V100 cuda12 engine only; driver 580.x accepts it.
